requirements.statement: Narrative, blueprint, machine, visual, test, and publication representations shall share stable scope IDs while retaining form-specific authority.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Modules shall be authored section-by-section in lockstep when representations apply, and substantive change shall invalidate and regenerate affected forms.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Parity validation shall cover identity, requirements, terminology, states, interfaces, permissions, failure/recovery, dependencies, visuals, publication, versions, hashes, and tests.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
